finding: The normalized source weight 0.25 is not a global cap on KO contribution. On 6722 target-gene pairs with no CRISPRi observation, only KO sources contribute and their common weight cancels in the ratio. These are full normalized KO estimates, followed by the already registered amplitude and cis handling.
decision: Keep the frozen T3 estimator and all 6722 pairs. This records the behavior of the existing formula and effects, not a post-generation modification.
scientific_interpretation: Technical comparison without ground truth. Direction of official-score change remains unknown; no source-level attribution or improvement claim.
public_description_addendum: 6722 KO-only target-gene pairs retain the full normalized KO estimate.
